;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[2014 pro-Russian conflict in Ukraine]]
**A [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukraine military]] [[Ilyushin Il-76]] airlifter [[Ukrainian Air Force Ilyushin Il-76 shoot-down|is shot down]], killing all 49 people on board. [http://edition.cnn.com/2014/06/13/world/europe/ukraine-crisis/ (CNN)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A bomb explodes in the town of [[al-Mayadin]] in [[Deir al-Zor]] province near the [[Iraq]]i border killing eight. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/06/14/us-syria-crisis-blast-idUSKBN0EP0E520140614 (Reuters)]

;Politics
*[[Alexander Stubb]] is elected new leader of the [[National Coalition Party]] and thus the new [[List of Prime Ministers of Finland|prime minister of Finland]], the first [[Swedish-speaking population of Finland|Swedish-speaking Finn]] to hold the post since 1959. [https://web.archive.org/web/20140714135118/http://hbl.fi/nyheter/2014-06-14/619376/stubb-mot-risikko-i-andra-omgangen (Hufvudstadsbladet)]
*[[2014 Afghan presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Afghanistan]] go to the polls for the second round of voting with the [[Taliban]] threatening polling booths. Dozens of people are killed across the country. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia/2014/06/afghans-elect-president-amid-taliban-threats-20146142933334123.html (al-Jazeera)], [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2014/06/14/afghan-vote-presidential-runoff/10515947/ (''USA Today'')]
